title: mind the wind
text: cast with the wind at your back and the lure will carry twice as far

title: still water runs deep
text: fish sit lower and slower once the sun is up; give the lure time to sink before you start reeling

title: worms never fail
text: when nothing else is biting go back to the plain worm - it's boring but it works

title: dawn is for biters
text: bite chances go up right at dawn - it's the best window to fish the far zone

title: let the rod rest
text: a rod with nothing assigned isn't earning anything - keep every slot filled
